//: Copy this file to config.json and fill in real values. config.json is gitignored.
//protocol: ftp (default) or sftp. Pterodactyl panels usually expose SFTP on port 2022.
//host: Hostname or IP of the server (no protocol prefix).
//port: FTP plain/explicit-TLS is usually 21. Pterodactyl SFTP is usually 2022.
//user: FTP/SFTP username. Pterodactyl SFTP usernames look like 'user.serverid'.
//secure: FTP only. true = explicit FTPS (FTP over TLS). false = plain FTP. Ignored for sftp.
//remoteBase: Remote directory the pack lives in. mods/ and config/ are created/synced under this. Typically '/' for Pterodactyl (the server root).
